{
  "summary": "The function fn_11 computes a value based on the input bytes and returns it. It does not modify the input or output buffers and does not use any external libraries or global state.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_11",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 1.0,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "claim_1",

      "text": "A loop iterates over the input bytes.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_2",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "The loop condition checks if the current pointer has reached the end of the input.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_3",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "The loop body updates the result by adding the current byte to the product of the result and 0x29.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_4",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns 0x1d35 when the input length is zero.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x1d35"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_5",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the computed value when the input length is non-zero.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_6",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to out.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_7",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not modify the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_8",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "The code uses the constant 0x29.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x29"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_9",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "The code uses the constant 0x1d35.",
      "asserted_values": ["0x1d35"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_11(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint64_t result = 0x1d35;\n  if (len != 0) {\n    const uint8_t *current = in;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n      result = (uint64_t)*current + result * 0x29;\n      current++;\n    }\n  }\n  return result;\n}"
}
